title: Earth and Environmental Sciences
description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 20 units of courses, with at least 6 units at 3000 or about level, as follows[a]:

courses.title: Solid Earth Dynamics
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC2010.

courses.title: Climate System Dynamics
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC2020.

courses.title: Introduction to Environmental Science
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ENSC2270.

courses.title: Ecology
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: LSCI1002 or LSCI1012.

courses.title: Marine Biology
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: BIOL2210

courses.title: Field and Environmental Biology
courses.prereq: Co-requisite: BIOL2210 and 3710.

courses.title: Global Change Biology
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: BIOL2210.

courses.title: Conservation Biology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ENSC4260. Pre-requisite: BIOL2210.

courses.title: Marine Microbial Ecology
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: BIOL3410.

courses.title: Environmental Chemistry
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ENSC2515. Pre-requisite: EESC2270 or ENSC2270 or permission of the instructor.

courses.title: Introduction to Environmental Engineering
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC2800. Pre-requisite: MATH1010 or 1510 or 1520.

courses.title: Structural Geology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3100. Pre-requisite: EESC2010 or ESSC2010 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Physics of the Earth
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3120. Pre-requisite: EESC 2010 or ESSC2010 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Geochemistry
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: (EESC2010 or ESSC2010) or (EESC2130 or ESSC2130 or EESC2119 or EESC2129) or (EESC3100 or ESSC3100) or permission of instructor

courses.title: Atmospheric Dynamics
courses.prereq: 1) Pre-requisite: (EESC2020 or ESSC2020) or (MATH2550 or EESC2520 or PHYS2051) or permission of instructor. 2) Not for students who have taken ESSC3200.

courses.title: Atmospheric Chemistry
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3220. Pre-requisite: CHEM1070 or CHEM1072 or CHEM1280 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Oceanography
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3300. Pre-requisite: (EESC2010 or ESSC2010) and (EESC2020 or ESSC2020), or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Hydrogeology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3320. Pre-requisite: EESC 2010 or ESSC2010 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Environmental Instrumentation Techniques
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken CHEM2400 or CHEM3410 or ENSC3415. Pre-requisite: EESC2515 or ENSC2515.

courses.title: Environmental Microbiology
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: LSCI1002 or LSCI1012 or EESC2270, or permission of the instructor.

courses.title: Quantitative Methods in Environmental Management
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ENSC3520. Pre-requisite: EESC2270 or permission of the instructor.

courses.title: Environmental Quality Monitoring and Analysis
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: (CHEM1070 or CHEM1072) or (EESC2515 or ENSC2515) or permission of the instructor.

courses.title: Ecological Climatology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3600 or EESC3601 or ESSC3601. Pre-requisite: EESC2020 or ESSC2020 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Principles of Ecological Climatology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3601 or EESC3600 or ESSC3600. Pre-requisite: EESC2020 or ESSC2020 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Global Environmental Change
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3800.

courses.title: Solid and Fluid Mechanics
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC3010 or 4010.

courses.title: Soil Mechanics and Its Applications
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4020. Pre-requisite: [(MATH1010 or 1030 or 1510 or 1520) or (PHYS1001 or 1002 or 1111 or 1113)] and (EESC2010 or ESSC2010), or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Engineering Geology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4030. Pre-requisite: [(EESC2130 or ESSC2130) or (EESC3100 or ESSC3100) or (EESC3110 or ESSC3110)] and EESC4040, or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Rock Mechanics and Its Applications
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: [(MATH1010 or 1030 or 1510 or 1520) or (EESC2130 or ESSC2130)] and (EESC3100 or ESSC3100), or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Applied Geophysics
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4110. Pre-requisite: (EESC2010 or ESSC2010) and (EESC3120 or ESSC3120).

courses.title: Petrology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4120. Pre-requisite: EESC2010 or ESSC2010.

courses.title: Geomorphology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4130. Pre-requisite: EESC3100 or ESSC3100.

courses.title: Seismology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4140. Pre-requisite: (EESC3120 or ESSC3120) or ESSC3010.

courses.title: Marine Geology and Geophysics
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4160. Pre-requisite: (EESC3120 or ESSC3120) or ESSC3010 or (EESC4010 or ESSC4010).

courses.title: Geodynamics
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: EESC2010 or ESSC2010.

courses.title: Earthquake Source Physics
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4180. Pre-requisite: (EESC3120 or ESSC3120) or (EESC4010 or ESSC4010) or (EESC4140 or ESSC4140).

courses.title: Land-Atmosphere Interactions and Boundary-Layer Meteorology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4210. Pre-requisite: (EESC2020 or ESSC2020) or (EESC3200 or ESSC3200) or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Tropical Meteorology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4220. Pre-requisite: EESC3200 or ESSC3200.

courses.title: Introduction to the Physics and Chemistry of Aerosol
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4230. Pre-requisite: EESC2020 or ESSC2020 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Air Pollution Science and Engineering
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4240.

courses.title: General Circulation and Climate Models
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4250. Pre-requisite: EESC3200 or ESSC3200 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Urban Climatology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4260. Pre-requisite: EESC2020 or ESSC2020.

courses.title: Cloud Dynamics
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: EESC2020 or ESSC2020.

courses.title: Practical Meteorology
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: EESC2020 or ESSC2020.

courses.title: Advanced Environmental Chemistry
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ENSC4525. Pre-requisite: EESC2515 or ENSC2515 or permission of the instructor.

courses.title: Biogeochemistry
courses.prereq: 1) Pre-requisite: EESC/ESSC3020 or EESC/ESSC3220 or EESC3230 or EESC/ESSC3300 or EESC3510 or EESC3520 or EESC/ESSC3600 or EESC/ESSC3800. 2) Not for those taken ENSC/EESC3330. 3) Need basic knowledge in environmental science and chemistry.

courses.title: Chemical Treatment Processes
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ENSC4535. Pre-requisite: EESC2515 or ENSC2515 or permission of the instructor.

courses.title: Environmental Health: A Systems Thinking Approach
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ENSC4250. Pre-requisite: EESC3520 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Statistical Methods and Data Analysis for Earth and Environmental Sciences
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4510. Pre-requisite: (STAT1011 or 1012), and ((EESC2030 or ESSC2030) or PHYS2061).

courses.title: Numerical Methods and Modeling for Earth and Environmental Sciences
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4520. Pre-requisite: (MATH1010 or 1030 or 1520), and ((EESC2030 or ESSC2030) or PHYS2061).

courses.title: Remote Sensing – Principles and Applications
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken ESSC4540. Pre-requisite: (EESC2010 or ESSC2010) &(EESC2020 or ESSC2020) & (MATH1010 or 1030 or 1510 or 1520) & (PHYS1001 or 1002 or 1111 or 1113) & ((EESC2030 or ESSC2030) or PHYS2061), or permission of instructor.

courses.title: Practical Atmospheric Modeling
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: (EESC2020 or ESSC2020) and (MATH2550 or EESC2520 or PHYS2051) and (PHYS1001 or 1002 or 1111 or 1113), or permission of instructor.

explanatory_notes:
Explanatory Note:

 

[a]

No more than 9 units of courses taken to fulfill the requirements of the students’ Major Programme(s) and other Minor Programme(s) respectively can be used to fulfill the requirement of this Minor Programme.
